description: Process specifications for independent one-loop provider references (MASTER_PLAN 5.6-5.7). Orders are amplitude coupling powers (g_s, e). Parameter values are exact decimal strings shared by every provider.

qcd.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-no_b_mass model: alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, massless b/tau/light fermions, all widths zero, five-flavour alpha_s renormalization with decoupled top, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

ew-gmu.description: Full NLO EW (all one-loop graphs of the selected order, QCD-EW mixed included) in the G_mu scheme with on-shell real masses, matching OpenLoops ew_scheme=1/ew_renorm_scheme=1 and the MG5 loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu default restriction (massless light fermions, diagonal CKM). Real on-shell mass renormalization (MadLoop complex_mass_scheme False, Recola set_on_shell_scheme, OpenLoops complex_mass_scheme=0) with all widths zero; stable top; Feynman gauge. Recola's default complex-mass scheme keeps absorptive self-energy parts in its counterterms even at zero widths and is therefore not used.

ew-gmu-mg5.description: The ew-gmu scheme on MG5_aMC's online-database download of loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu (its MG5 Python-3 conversion), whose R2_ZZHH predates UFOmodeldb's fix 1f13c48f / 6ca4b120 (the only difference): the control run of SC10 (MS-UFODB).

ew-qcd-qed-sm.description: Full NLO EW in MG5_aMC's loop_qcd_qed_sm (alpha(M_Z) scheme: aEWM1, MZ and MW all inputs; lhv=1, epsUV=epsIR=1) at its default restriction (massless light fermions, diagonal CKM), real on-shell masses with all widths zero, stable top, Feynman gauge. MadLoop only: the Recola and OpenLoops drivers have no translation of these inputs.

ew-gmu-b-mass.description: The ew-gmu scheme with a massive b (MB = ymb = 4.5): every fermion line through a chiral W vertex is massive (pyAmpliCol refuses a line joining massive and massless fermions through one). The MadLoop model is a copy of loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu_py3 whose restrict_default.dat keeps MB and ymb (4.5) and this scheme's MH = 125 (the UFO's own restrict_with_b_mass.dat has MH = 120; before the UFOmodeldb issue-1 patch it also lacked SMINPUTS 1, which MG5 3.7.0 needs).

qcd-4fs.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm model at its default restriction (four-flavour scheme): massive b (MB = ymb = 4.7) and tau (MTA = ymtau = 1.777) at the card values, alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, all widths zero (= the no_widths restriction), four active flavours (b and top decoupled from alpha_s), six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

qcd-cmass.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-c_mass model: massive c (MC = ymc = 1.55) and b (MB = ymb = 4.7), tau at the card value, alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, all widths zero, three active flavours, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

qcd-ckm.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-zeromass_ckm model: massless b and tau, non-diagonal CKM from the Wolfenstein card values (lamWS, AWS, rhoWS, etaWS), alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, all widths zero, five active flavours, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

qcd-ckm4.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-ckm model: massive b (MB = ymb = 4.7) and tau at the card values, non-diagonal CKM from the Wolfenstein card values, alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, all widths zero, four active flavours, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

qcd-lmass.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-lepton_masses model: massive e (Me = yme = 5.11e-4), mu (MM = ymm = 0.10566) and tau (1.777), massive b (MB = ymb = 4.7), alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, all widths zero, four active flavours, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

qcd-widths.description: The qcd scheme (MG5 loop_sm-no_b_mass) with the colourless widths at the card values (WZ = 2.441404, WW = 2.0476, WH = 6.38233934e-03; fixed widths in the propagators, real masses elsewhere) and a stable top (WT = 0).

ew-gmu-a0.description: The ew-gmu scheme on the loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu restriction a0 (restrict_a0.dat: aEW0M1 = 137.035999 kept). No coupling or counterterm parameter of the G_mu UFO uses aEW0, so MadLoop's raw values equal ew-gmu's; aEW0M1 enters only MG5's alpha(0) formula for tagged photons, which MadLoop standalone does not apply.

ew-gmu-cms.description: The ew-gmu values under MG5's complex-mass scheme (set complex_mass_scheme True) on the default restriction: complex masses sqrt(M^2 - i M Gamma) for t, Z, W, H at the card widths of restrict_default.dat (WT = 1.37758, WZ = 2.49877, WW = 2.09291, WH = 0.00407468); a process with an external unstable multiplet sets its width to 0 (parameter_overrides). Under CMS MG5 removes the YUKAWA inputs (ymX := the complex mass), so no Yukawa is set.

conventions.GfRedefinitionChoice: 1 (fixed by the restriction card: alpha_Gmu = sqrt(2) Gf |mu_W^2 (1 - mu_W^2/mu_Z^2)| / pi)
conventions.ghost_widths: zero (the UFO's ghosts carry no width; MadLoop's loop denominators use the complex mass)

ew-gmu-a0-cms.description: The ew-gmu-cms scheme on the a0 restriction (aEW0M1 = 137.035999 kept), for tagged photons under CMS.

conventions.GfRedefinitionChoice: 1 (fixed by the restriction card: alpha_Gmu = sqrt(2) Gf |mu_W^2 (1 - mu_W^2/mu_Z^2)| / pi)
conventions.ghost_widths: zero (the UFO's ghosts carry no width; MadLoop's loop denominators use the complex mass)

qcd-cms.description: QCD corrections in MG5's loop_sm-no_b_mass under the complex-mass scheme with a top width only. MG5 3.7.0 refuses loop_sm under CMS unless its electroweak inputs switch ('sminputs (2,) not define' whenever no W width is set at import), and with the card's W width it switches loop_sm to (aEWM1, MZ, MW) inputs (change_electroweak_mode); MW is therefore set to the tree-level value the qcd scheme derives from (aEWM1, Gf, MZ), so every coupling equals the alpha_fixed scheme's. WT at the card value 1.4915, WZ = WW = WH = 0 at run time (only the top mass is complex); no CMSParam in loop_sm.

conventions.electroweak_inputs: MG5's CMS switch of loop_sm to (aEWM1, MZ, MW); MW = the qcd scheme's tree-level value

ew-gmu-ckm.description: The ew-gmu values on the loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu restriction ckm (restrict_ckm.dat): complex CKM from the card's Wolfenstein values (lamWS = 0.2253, AWS = 0.808, rhoWS = 0.132, etaWS = 0.341), massive b (MB = ymb = 4.7) and tau (MTA = ymtau = 1.777), all widths zero.
ew-gmu-ckm.ir_single_pole_remnant: the EW counterterms omit the tau mass (a retained limitation of the UFOmodeldb issue-1 patch, whose exactly unitary CKM removed the O(lambda^3) Wolfenstein remnant of -2.1e-2 (alpha/2pi) Born): with MTA = 1.777 the EW sector's single pole of u d~ > e+ ve exceeds the IR prediction by MTA^2/(2 sw^2 (s - MW^2)) (alpha/2pi) Born (about 3e-5 at sqrt(s) = 500 GeV; a model property the engine on the same UFO reproduces; rule 4 on SC03 sees it)

ew-gmu-mm.description: The ew-gmu values on the massive-muon copy loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu_massive_muon_py3 (MM = ymm = 0.105658). The copy changes only the restriction card: its muon counterterms are the massless muon's (CT_parameters.py has no MM), so the IR single pole exceeds the massive-muon one by 3/2 Q^2 (alpha/2pi) Born per muon leg up to O(m_mu^2/M_W^2) Yukawa terms (massless_field_counterterms; the on-shell field renormalisation's IR pole; a model property the engine on the same UFO reproduces, seen by rule 4 on SC02 and LL02).

ew-gmu-tech.description: loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu on restrict_with_technical.dat at its own masses (MT = ymt = 174.3, MH = 120) with all widths zero; the TECHNICAL block stays a card input (epsUV, epsIR, LogSwitch, GfRedefinitionChoice), so a process may run at epsIR = 0 (UV part of the counterterms alone).
